page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisor technology. The instance provides 56 dedicated vCPUs alongside 224 GB of system memory, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Hardware compute acceleration is delivered via two NVIDIA Pascal-generation P100 GPUs, offering a combined 32 GB of VRAM. Storage needs are addressed by 944 GB of attached local SSD storage, and networking capabilities are defined by a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

The integration of dual graphics processing units with substantial host memory provides parallel compute capabilities for matrix operations. However, the Pascal-era GPU hardware lacks dedicated tensor cores and modern CPU extension flags such as AVX-512, presenting a throughput tradeoff when compared against newer accelerator generations. The presence of 944 GB local SSD storage yields low-latency disk access for intermediate datasets. This hardware profile is structured for legacy deep learning training pipelines, computer vision processing, scientific simulation tasks, and parallel compute workloads.
